definitions.explanation: Used before adjectives to form superlatives, meaning 'the most' or '-est'.
The first in order or rank; the best among a group.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一番|いちばん}⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一番|いちばん}⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The highest mountain in Japan is Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一番|いちばん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Health is the most important thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一番|いちばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りたい→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be number one in my class.
examples.notes: 一番を取る = to take first place

notes:
{一番|いちばん} functions as both an adverb (superlative marker) and a noun (number one, first place). The kanji literally mean "one" (⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧) + "number/turn" (⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧).

SUPERLATIVE PATTERN:
{一番|いちばん} + adjective = "most" or "-est":
- {一番|いちばん}⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: biggest
- {一番|いちばん}⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧: like the most
- {一番|いちばん}⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧: most important

Scope is specified with ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一番|いちばん} (in the world), ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一番|いちばん} (in the class).

NOUN USAGE:
- {一番|いちばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come first (in order)
- {一番|いちばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take first place
- {一番|いちばん}⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧: the most important thing (as noun phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦もっとも→最も：01736_mottomo⟧ (⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧): formal/written equivalent for "most"
- ⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧: first place (rankings, competitions)
